camera.state: static (static objects jitter < 0.2 px over all 48 frames)
camera.perspective: background removed; no visible floor/horizon. Objects appear to rest on a floor seen obliquely from above (notebook top face visible, cup seen from above). Box moves up-left in the image and shrinks -> receding from the camera.

blue_box.desc: blue box/toy with yellow and white patches (small white wheel/foot visible on underside), the only moving object

cup.desc: small white/grey cup or tumbler with dark lid, left of centre

notebook.desc: white rectangular package/notebook with green print (green print keyed out as holes), bottom centre, rotated ~30 deg

watermark.desc: "Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo" label, bottom right (x>1030, y>690); not an object

events.box_motion: already moving at frame 0 and still moving at frame 47 (no start/stop in clip); image speed decreases over the clip (see per_frame_step_px)
events.box_closest_to_basketball: frame 0 (box right edge x=965, ball left edge x~953, gap only diagonal; masks do not touch)
